$description: UBS Design System — Illustration Tokens. Source: ubs.frontify.com

style.lineWeight: Firm pen stroke. Minimum 1px in digital. Optically adjust when scaling.
style.levelOfDetail: Abstract where possible, accurate where appropriate. Grasp the essence.
style.humanProportions: NOT realistic: small head, short torso, long legs, large feet

colourLayering.$description: Apply in this order, building up from simple to complex.
layers: 1. Black lines with accent Red lines
2. Black lines with accent Red fill
3. Black lines, Red accent fill, Black fill
4. Black lines, Red accent fill, Black and Warm Grays fill

additionalColour.name: Bordeaux II
additionalColour.usage: ~10% of illustration. For large/complex illustrations only.

animation.movement: Natural, human-like. No stiffness or cartoonish.
